faqs.q: Do I need to be good with technology?
faqs.a: No. Catequese Viva was designed to work on your phone and stay simple from the first meeting.

faqs.q: Do I have to register my whole class at once?
faqs.a: No. You can start with a few catechumens and add the rest later.

faqs.q: Can I use it just for my class?
faqs.a: Yes. The Catechist Plan was made for exactly that.

faqs.q: What if I later want to organize my parish?
faqs.a: You can move to the Parish Plan and create a space for your team.
Not necessarily. It organizes catechesis information and communication so you don't depend on scattered messages.

faqs.q: Do I need a card to try it?
faqs.a: No. You can start the 7 free days without entering a card.
